rules.rule: Only escalate to a 100k run to confirm a clear 10k signal that is worth confirming.
Do actual web research on established approaches to the specific problem (CSI feedback / NLOS localization / channel charting) before proposing or running experiments.
Do not delete the Claude home backup at `C:\Users\javid\Documents\Javier\.claude`, because it is the only copy of the pre-crash state.
Before editing a figure SVG, read the region of the file being changed first.
When generating a new RT dataset (especially one with a high indoor fraction), apply the zero-norm UE filter (min_norm_frac=1e-3 via build_multitask_feeds) before training.
When addressing joint-training negative transfer, test staged training first and use PCGrad or ForkMerge only if a residual gap remains.
Do not re-run convert_channel_angle_delay on the RT-generated CSI, because it is already in the delay domain; only the angular DFT should be applied.
Do not launch the real CSI-representation training run until the user gives explicit go-ahead.
Test the pure-NLOS configuration first and defer the LOS/NLOS comparison that requires re-aiming the azimuth.
Do not pursue single-snapshot self-aiding (a self-derived prior from one codeword) any further.
Do not implement the TR 38.901 §8.4 map-based hybrid channel model; cite it instead.
Never use stochastic-cluster perturbation during training.
Do not build an ns-3 + 5G-LENA + ns3-rt integration.
When republishing the walkthrough Artifact, use the same file path so the existing URL is kept.
When running the CSI-representation experiment, run the 10k proxy first, then confirm the result on 100k data.
Hold the per-layer model retrain until the user picks which lever to pursue.
Do not delete F:\Javier_old\users-fernando until the new backup has been verified as trustworthy.
Do not edit memory content when restoring.
Never open memory.db from node -e debug scripts while the MCP server is running.
Do not rename memory files when restoring.
Do not create MEMORY.md from scratch; only copy the existing memory/MEMORY.md.
Never add a scripts/patches/NNN-PATCH-*.sh file for changes to the viz/ directory.
Never edit .claude/helpers/ directly as the source of truth; update it only by re-running the bootstrap.
After editing a hook script, do not restart any daemon, because the next hook invocation will pick up the change.
Before saving a memory, ask whether it would apply in any project or only in this one.
Do not make code changes when asked to analyze or review, unless explicitly asked to implement them.
Only write code when the user explicitly says to apply, fix, implement, or do it.
Do not run tests, lint, typecheck, or builds after implementing a change.
Do not run end-to-end verification, such as the /verify skill or launching the app and driving it.
Do not execute test files you wrote as part of an implementation.
Do not run git commit until the user has reviewed the change and explicitly approved it, even if prior slices in the repo were committed one per issue.
Run verification or checks only when the user explicitly asks for them in that conversation.
When the user invokes /tdd, run only single targeted tests in the red-green loop, and never run full suites, builds, lint, or typecheck.
Ask for or wait for user approval before running git commit.
Close the completed ticket only after the git commit succeeds.
Do not let harness or skill prompts suggesting verification override the rule against running verification without user request.
Do not treat repo commit history patterns as authorization to run git commit.
Investigate and fix blocker bug #71 on a hotfix branch, regardless of the 4-day waiting rule.
Treat docs/design-system.md as the single source of truth for all UI work, and read it before implementing or reviewing any screen.
Never run `docker compose up --build -d` for all services during development.
Write and run the e2e test before opening the PR; do not merely plan it.
Before running individual e2e tests outside Docker with `npx playwright test`, make sure the dev stack (sqlserver, api, frontend) is running locally.
Do not run tests decorated with `[SkipIfNoClaudeApiKey]` by default; they run only when explicitly opted in.
Never commit the Claude API key to the repository.
Write task plan files inside the active worktree, not in the main repo directory.
Do not write task plan files in the main repo directory.
Never save plan files directly in the root `plan\` folder.
Place each phase's plan files in a feature subfolder for that phase.
Name the phase overview file `plan.md` and place it inside the phase's subfolder.
Name individual task files `task<N>-<short-description>.md` and place them in the same phase subfolder as the overview.
